name: whoop
description: Your WHOOP recovery, sleep, strain and workouts, with the WHOOP dashboard's trends and insights, read live from WHOOP with your own WHOOP app.

setup.title: Open the WHOOP Developer Dashboard
setup.body: Sign in with the same WHOOP account you wear the strap with. You need a WHOOP app of your own: it's free and needs no review, because only you use it. If you already have one (for example the app your WHOOP dashboard uses), you can reuse it: skip to "Or reuse an app you already have".

setup.title: New app: create a team
setup.body: The dashboard asks for a team before your first app. Click Get Started, type any name (for example your own), and click Create Team. If you already have a team, skip this step.

setup.title: New app: create it
setup.body: Click Create App. Give it any name, and tick these scopes: `read:recovery`, `read:cycles`, `read:workout`, `read:sleep`, `read:profile`, `read:body_measurement`. In Redirect URIs, paste the address below exactly as shown. Leave the Webhook URL empty: xaq reads WHOOP when your agents ask and doesn't use webhooks. Then click Create. If WHOOP refuses this address (for example because it isn't https), give this install an https public URL in Settings and come back: this step will then show the new address. Without an https address, enter `https://localhost/oauth/connections/callback` instead; after you approve, your browser shows an error page, and you paste that page's full address back here.

setup.title: Or reuse an app you already have
setup.body: Open Apps, click your app, then click the pencil icon to edit it. Under Redirect URIs, add the address below as one more URI, and keep the ones already there (an app may have several, and whatever else uses the app still needs its own). Check that the scopes `read:recovery`, `read:cycles`, `read:workout`, `read:sleep`, `read:profile` and `read:body_measurement` are ticked, then save. Don't click the red trash can: it deletes the app.

setup.title: Paste the client ID
setup.body: WHOOP shows a Client ID and a Client Secret on the app's page. To see them again, open the app from the Apps list. Copy the Client ID here.

input.label: Client ID
input.placeholder: Client ID from the WHOOP app

setup.title: Paste the client secret
setup.body: Copy the Client Secret here. xaq stores it encrypted, never shows it again and never gives it to the extension. It's checked with WHOOP right away.

setup.title: Connect and approve
setup.body: Click Connect. WHOOP asks you to sign in and approve access to your recovery, sleep, cycles, workouts, profile and body measurements. Approve everything: the extension only reads, and xaq keeps the connection alive on its own. Agents get your data live from WHOOP; days WHOOP has finished scoring are cached on this machine so long trends stay fast.
